scope: All1117 queries and5405 reference rows, SHA-collapsed ranking; frozen original embeddings, no OCR, no human boxes used by the new matching scores.
hypotheses: Unilateral MaxSim may reward one-sided shared content
Many query tokens choosing the same gallery token may inflate a match
Template tokens may confound the direction/collision controls
balanced_definition: Each gallery token that wins at least one query contributes one equal-weight group mean, instead of weighting groups by the number of query tokens assigned. No semantic or identity interpretation of repeated matches is assumed.
selection: For each method choose mixture with original score on the existing validation identities by macroTop1, macroMRR, then lower intervention weight. Report all curves and harms; do not select by full/test accuracy.
limitation: Historical split already studied, not fresh blind evaluation. Candidate token counts/background differ; reverse and balancing are diagnostic controls, not a priori correct identity scorers. Failure of these methods does not rule out other spatial or relational matching methods.
